description:
Subscribe an HTTPS URL to push alerts instead of polling (Pro: 3, Bot: 20 subscriptions).
    type='condition': YOUR OWN trigger on one symbol — fires when `metric` `op` `threshold` becomes
    true (edge-triggered: once per crossing, again only after it was false). metric = funding_apr_pct
    (median annualised funding across venues) | oi_chg_1h_pct | oi_chg_24h_pct (Binance+Bybit+OKX, in
    coins) | liq_1h_usd | liq_24h_usd | price_chg_1h_pct | price_chg_24h_pct (Binance mark) | long_pct
    (mean long share of accounts) — the SAME definitions test_rule backtests, so test a rule first and
    alert on it after; op = gt | lt. Example: symbol='BTC', metric='funding_apr_pct', op='gt',
    threshold=50. The payload carries the value, the threshold and every other metric as context.
    Checked every 60 s.
    type='position': YOUR OWN position (symbol, side, entry, leverage, notional_usd, venue) — fires when it is
    within max_dist_pct of its liquidation price, computed every 60 s from the venue's maintenance-margin
    tier and the live mark (same numbers as check_position); again only when it gets a whole percent closer.
    type='cascade': a liquidation cascade just ended, over min_usd and x_normal times the coin's
    normal minute. type='hl_near_liq': a Hyperliquid whale position over min_usd within
    max_dist_pct of its liquidation price. type='cluster_sweep': price reached one of the 10
    largest modeled liquidation-map clusters (size over min_usd; no symbol = BTC, ETH, SOL), sent
    3 min later with modeled vs actually liquidated USD. Returns the signing secret ONCE: verify header
    X-LiquidVision-Signature = hex HMAC-SHA256(secret, raw body). Needs a Pro or Bot key.

api_key.description: LiquidVision API key (lv_...). Omit when the key is sent as the X-API-Key header on the connection.
api_key.title: Api Key

max_dist_pct.description: Only positions whose liquidation price is within this many percent of the mark price.
max_dist_pct.title: Max Dist Pct

metric.description: Condition metric: funding_apr_pct | oi_chg_1h_pct | oi_chg_24h_pct | liq_1h_usd | liq_24h_usd | price_chg_1h_pct | price_chg_24h_pct | long_pct.
metric.title: Metric

min_usd.description: Only rows at or above this notional in USD.
min_usd.title: Min Usd

symbol.description: Contract as BASEUSDT, e.g. BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT, SOLUSDT (1000PEPE and kPEPE fold to PEPEUSDT).
symbol.title: Symbol

threshold.description: Threshold the metric is compared with, in the metric's own unit (percent or USD).
threshold.title: Threshold

type.description: Type id, one of the values listed in the description.
type.title: Type

url.description: HTTPS endpoint that will receive the POST deliveries.
url.title: Url

venue.description: type=position: venue whose margin tiers and mark to use (default binance).
venue.title: Venue

x_normal.description: Minimum cascade size as a multiple of the coin's normal minute of liquidations.
x_normal.title: X Normal
